chunks: The Shaykh, may Allah Most High support him, informed me from Abū al-Qāsim Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād, from al-Ḥalabī, who said:
I heard Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام saying: “If the junub immerses himself in water in a single immersion, that suffices him for his ghusl.”

key_terms.أَجْزَأَهُ: it sufficed him and fulfilled the requirement
key_terms.ارْتِمَاسَةً: a complete act of immersion into water
key_terms.الْجُنُبُ: a person in the state of janabah requiring ghusl

ai.seo_question: Is one full immersion in water sufficient for ghusl al-janabah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning ghusl for janabah. It states that for a person in the state of janabah, one complete immersion in water is sufficient to fulfill the required ghusl.
